recall.query: curriculum topics exercises assessment resources learning

draft.prompt:
Write the next module of the {subject} training curriculum ({skill_level} level).

Curriculum outline:
{curriculum_outline}

Topic research findings:
{topic_research}

Memory search results:
{relevant_research}

Previous module drafts:
{module_draft}

Iteration: {iteration}

Write the next unwritten module from the outline. Each module must include:
- Module title and week number
- Learning objectives (3-5 measurable objectives)
- Topics covered (with brief descriptions)
- Exercises (2-3 hands-on activities with clear instructions)
- Assessment (quiz questions, project deliverable, or skill demonstration)
- Resources (readings, tools, videos)
- Estimated time breakdown (lectures, exercises, self-study)

Make exercises concrete and actionable. Assessment criteria should be specific and measurable.
